meta.name: minimal-run-and-audit
meta.description: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通论文仓库的推理或评估命令,归档成可复核的复现结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有需要复现的深度学习论文仓库,想留下可核查的运行证据
copy.tagline_en: Run a paper repo's documented commands and archive checkable reproduction evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must reproduce a deep-learning paper repo and keep verifiable run evidence

howto.what: Claude 会把已选定的冒烟测试或 README 记录的推理/评估命令跑一遍，把结果写成 repro_outputs/ 标准文件，并生成 SCIENTIFIC_CHANGELOG.md 等报告，改动仓库文件时另出 PATCHES.md。
howto.when: 在复现目标与 setup 计划已经确定之后，当你已知道要跑的冒烟测试或推理/评估命令、只想拿到执行证据和报告时接管；不负责初次扫描仓库、训练执行或挑选目标。

say.text: 跑这个冒烟测试命令，把结果整理进 repro_outputs/，并附上报告。
say.note: 会执行并写成标准文件与报告

say.text: 把 README 里的评估命令跑一遍并写入报告。
这次改了仓库文件，请把补丁写进 PATCHES.md。
say.note: 仅在仓库文件被改动时生成

howto.what_en: Claude runs the smoke test or the inference/evaluation command documented in the README, writes results as standard repro_outputs/ files, and generates reports such as SCIENTIFIC_CHANGELOG.md plus PATCHES.md when repo files changed.
howto.when_en: When a reproduction target and setup plan exist and the command to run is already known, it captures execution evidence and writes repro_outputs/ reports; not for scanning, training, or target choice.

say_en.text: Run this smoke test command, write results into repro_outputs/ with a report.
say_en.note: Runs it and writes standard files plus reports

say_en.text: Run the README evaluation command and write a report.
I changed repo files; add the patches to PATCHES.md.
say_en.note: Only generated when repo files changed
